text:
Priya G: Quick update — candidate Diego Martinez now flying in same-day (arrives 08:50 PT) so we'll need to shift the morning loop by 30 mins. Two ops asks: 1) pre-register and mark "will arrive late", 2) have a Linux loaner imaged (Ubuntu) + VPN by 08:15. Diet: gluten-free. Also needs short private room for a pair-programming exercise at ~10:45.

Mark L: I can juggle the panel. Which interviews should move?

Priya G: Move the system-design from 09:30 -> 10:00, coding from 10:15 -> 10:45, keep 13:00 pm slot as-is. I'll update invites.

RecruiterBot: Candidate flight updated. ETA campus 09:15 with taxi. Notifying front desk.

FrontDeskBot: Prereg submitted. badge_ref=RV-5022. Flagged: "late arrival" and "gluten-free". Please add escort name. PDF uploaded to #people-ops-uploads.

IT Support: We have loaner-linux-03. Will image with Ubuntu 22.04 and pre-config corp VPN. Please DM candidate email for account creation. ETA imaging finish 08:00.

Priya G: Email: diego.martinez+candidate@example.com. Also Diego prefers quiet room for 1:1; please reserve Quiet Room C 10:40-11:10.

CateringTeam: Noted gluten-free. Ordering boxed lunch labeled "Diego  GF" and marking nut-free as precaution.

Mark L: Confirmed I can swap my notes and cover the 10:45 coding slot. I'll ping the panel to accept the new times.

IT Support: Imaging done 07:50. Username diego.martinez+candidate@example.com created. VPN test passed. Laptop assigned loaner-linux-03.

Priya G: Parking: give candidate validation code "GATE-GF" at exit. Expense code for travel reimbursements: CAND-REIMB-2026 — receipts to expenses@redwood.com.

FrontDeskBot: Badge printed. Escort assigned: Mark L. Lobby pickup: main entrance, 09:10.

RecruiterBot: Candidate messaged with updated schedule and pickup details. Diego replied: "Thanks — see you at 09:10, I'll bring ID."

Priya G: Great. Closing loop unless anyone sees a conflict. Reply here if anything changes.

Mark L: All good from me. See you tomorrow. :thumbsup:

CateringTeam: Catering confirmation sent to Priya.

IT Support: Standing by for last-minute changes.
